AccountDetails.description:
What the terminal shows about an account, set by the firm's systems. Label names it for the trader,
for example "#1001 Two-step 100K · Phase 1". ProfitTarget is the balance that passes it.
TimeZone is its trading day's, which the terminal shows times in. DetailsUrl is
where the trader sees more about it, for example the account in the firm's portal. Each is null when not set.

AccountDetailsRequest.description:
What the terminal shows about an account: Label names it for the trader, ProfitTarget
is the balance that passes it, TimeZone its trading day's (IANA) and DetailsUrl where
the trader sees more about it. Empty for none.

AccountImpact.description:
An account with positions open when the period began, with commands refused during it for lack of a fresh price, or
with a loss limit broken during it or in the half hour after. EquityAtStart is the equity when
the period began at the prices of that moment, or null when a price was missing. Status,
Balance and Equity are as the account is now.

AccountRules.description:
The account's rules as the firm's system sees them now, which the terminal shows and warns about (ADR 0052). Each
is null when the account has no such rule. Funded tells a funded account, whose trading days
count toward a payout rather than passing the stage. PassBy is when the stage fails unless it was
passed, and OpenPositionBy when the account ends unless a position is opened before.
ConsistencyPercent is the most of the profit the best trading day may have made for a payout,
and BestDayPercent what it has made now.

AccountRulesRequest.description:
The account's rules as the firm's system sees them now, which the terminal shows and warns about (ADR 0052). Every
field is replaced, and one left out is cleared. See AccountRules.

AccountSnapshot.description: Account state valued at the latest prices, with the trader's own limits. Amounts are in account currency.

BalanceOperationRequest.description:
Deposits a positive Amount or withdraws a negative one. The caller chooses
OperationId, unique per account, so a retry is answered 409 instead of being applied
twice. A withdrawal must leave at least MinBalance.

BreachPrice.description:
A price the account saw when the limit was broken, received at ReceivedAt, with the feed's raw
price and the markup between them, or null when they cannot be found.

BreachReport.description:
Why a loss limit was broken (ADR 0053): the limit, the equity and the open positions at that moment, the prices
that broke it with the feed's prices behind them, equity price by price before it, the periods without prices and
the account's events, ending with the closes and the end of trading. Balance is the balance
before the closes and BalanceAfter after them.

Candle.description: Bar of bid prices. Time is the start of the bar in UTC.

ChangeGroupSymbolsRequest.description: Every symbol the group should trade, with its conditions. Symbols left out are removed.

CloseAllPositionsRequest.description: Closes the positions in Symbol. Without it, every position.

ClosePositionRequest.description: Closes only Volume of the position. Without it, the whole position.

CommandResponse.description: The events a command caused, in order.

CreateAccountRequest.description: Creates a trading account owned by a user of the same firm.

CreatedTenantResponse.description: A new firm, with the key to its admin API. The key is shown only once.

CreateLoginLinkRequest.description: A login link for the user. With an account id, the terminal opens that account.

CreateTenantRequest.description:
A firm with its server Id, which traders log in to, and its name. Currency is its
accounts' currency, one of `Tenancy:Currencies`, or the template groups' own when left out.

EngineEvent.description: Output from the engine. The timestamp is the timestamp of the input that caused it.

EngineEventAccountReopened.description: A disabled account is open again with the balance, without floors (ADR 0053).

EngineEventAccountSuspended.description: The account takes no new positions or orders until it is resumed. Its pending orders were cancelled just before.

EngineEventBalanceAdjusted.description: Money was deposited (positive amount) or withdrawn (negative amount). Not a trading result.

EngineEventEquityFloorBreached.description: Equity fell below a floor. Holds the evidence at the moment of the breach, before positions are closed.

EngineEventGroupCreated.description: A trading group was created. Its symbols are in symbol order.

EngineEventGroupSymbolsChanged.description: A created group's symbols changed. Holds the whole group as it is now, with its symbols in symbol order.

EngineEventOrderModified.description: A pending order got a new price, stop loss, take profit or trailing stop.

EngineEventOrderPlaced.description: A limit or stop order was accepted and waits for its price. TrailingDistance is set for a trailing stop.

EngineEventOwnLimitReached.description: Equity reached the trader's own daily loss limit or profit target. Positions close and new orders lock right after.

EngineEventOwnLimitsSet.description: The trader's own limits now, and Pending from the next trading day when they loosened one (ADR 0054).

EngineEventPositionClosed.description: A position was closed. Profit and commission are in account currency.

EngineEventPositionModified.description:
The trader set a position's stops. The moves a trailing stop makes on its own give no event: like a trailing floor's,
they follow from the prices, and the account shows where the stop loss is.

EngineEventPositionOpened.description:
A position was opened. The position id is the id of the order that opened it. TrailingDistance is
set for a trailing stop.

EngineEventPositionPartiallyClosed.description:
Part of a position was closed. Volume is the part closed, and RemainingVolume
stays open with the same id. Profit and commission are for the part, in account currency.

EngineEventStopOutTriggered.description: The margin level fell below the stop out level. Positions are closed, largest loss first.

EngineEventTradingDaySet.description: The account's trading day now starts as told, the next time at NextDayStart (ADR 0054).

EngineEventTradingDayStarted.description:
A trading day started on an account with own limits or a lock: the limits counted from DayStartBalance,
Limits are those for the day, and the day ends at NextDayStart.

EngineEventTradingLocked.description:
New orders are locked until Until, the start of the next trading day (ADR 0054). Limit
is the own limit that was reached, null when the trader locked the day. DayResult is equity at the
lock less the balance the day started with, and PositionsClosed how many positions the lock closed.

EngineEventTradingUnlocked.description: A new trading day started, or the firm reopened the account, so new orders are taken again.

EngineInput.description:
Input to the engine. The timestamp is set by the service when the input arrives
and must never be earlier than the previous input.

EngineInputAdjustBalance.description:
Deposits a positive Amount or withdraws a negative one. The caller chooses
OperationId, which is never reused on the account, so a retry cannot apply it twice.
A withdrawal must leave the balance at or above MinBalance, fit in the free margin
and keep equity above every floor.

EngineInputChangeGroupSymbols.description:
Replaces the symbols and their conditions of a group created with CreateGroup, for example when
the firm changes its leverage or commission. Configured groups are changed in the configuration. Open positions
and pending orders take the new conditions at once. A symbol can only be removed while no account in the group
has a position or an order in it.

EngineInputCloseAccount.description: Closes all positions at the latest prices, cancels all orders and disables the account.

EngineInputCloseAllPositions.description:
Closes every position on the account, or only those in Symbol, at the same moment. Positions whose
market is closed or has no fresh price stay open. Pending orders stay.

EngineInputClosePosition.description: Closes a position, or only Volume of it. The rest stays open with the same id.

EngineInputCreateGroup.description:
Creates a trading group, for example for a firm that signed up. Its currency and stop out level never change
afterwards, but its symbols can (see ChangeGroupSymbols).

EngineInputLockTrading.description:
The trader locks new orders until the next trading day, which nobody can undo (ADR 0054). Pending orders are cancelled.
With ClosePositions every position closes too, except one whose market has no fresh price now.

EngineInputModifyOrder.description: Moves a pending order to a new price, and sets its stop loss, take profit and trailing stop as for PlaceOrder.

EngineInputModifyPosition.description:
Sets stop loss and take profit. An empty value removes it. With TrailingStop the stop loss
follows the price at the distance it is set at from the price the position closes at now.

EngineInputPlaceOrder.description:
Places an order. Price is required for limit and stop orders and must be empty for market orders.
With TrailingStop the stop loss follows the price at the distance it is set at: from the price the
position closes at now for a market order, and from the order price for a limit or stop order.

EngineInputQuote.description: Raw price from the feed, before spread markup.

EngineInputReopenAccount.description:
Opens a disabled account again with Balance, for example when an outage broke a loss limit and the
firm reinstates the trader (ADR 0053). Its floors are removed, so the firm sets them again. Its positions and orders
were closed when it was disabled.

EngineInputResumeAccount.description: Lets a suspended account trade again.

EngineInputSetEquityFloor.description: Adds or replaces a named equity floor on the account.

EngineInputSetOwnLimits.description:
The trader's own limits (ADR 0054). Each limit that is stricter than now applies at once; each that is looser, or
turned off, applies from the next trading day.

EngineInputSetTradingDay.description:
Sets when the account's trading day starts, as the firm's system counts it (ADR 0054). Until it is set, the day starts
at midnight UTC. The day going on keeps running until the next start of the new day.

EngineInputSuspendAccount.description:
Stops new positions on the account, for example while the firm's bill is unpaid. Pending orders are
cancelled. Open positions stay: the owner can close them and change their stops, and stops and floors still hold.

EquityFloorRule.description:
Rule for an equity floor. When equity falls below the floor, all positions are closed,
all pending orders are cancelled and the account is disabled.

EquityFloorRuleAnchoredFloor.description:
A floor Distance below the account as it is when the floor is set: its balance, or
the higher of balance and equity. The level then stays fixed. Setting it again at the start of every
trading day gives a daily loss limit, with the level taken in the same step as the prices.

EquityFloorRuleFixedFloor.description: A fixed floor in account currency.

EquityFloorRuleTrailingFloor.description: A floor that trails the highest observed equity by Distance and stops rising at LockLevel.

EquityPoint.description: The account's equity at a price.

EventEnvelope.description: An engine event with a sequence number that orders all events in the service.

FeedPrice.description: A raw price from the feed as the journal recorded it, with its entry in the journal.

FirmEventsResponse.description: The firm's events in order. Ask again with `after` set to Cursor for the next ones.

FirmGroupResponse.description: One of the firm's trading groups. Only a Changeable group, created for the firm, can get other symbols.

FloorAnchor.description: What an AnchoredFloor is measured from when it is set.

FloorSnapshot.description: An equity floor. Headroom is how far equity can fall before the floor is breached.

GroupSymbol.description:
A symbol a group trades. Margin is the position's value divided by Leverage. SpreadMarkupPoints
are added to the price feed's spread, and CommissionPerLotPerSide is charged in the account currency both on open
and on close.

ImpactBreach.description: A loss limit broken during the period or soon after.

IncidentImpact.description: What happened to a firm's accounts in a period, such as an outage of the price feed (ADR 0053).

InstrumentCategory.description: What kind of market an instrument is. The terminal lists instruments by it.

InstrumentInfo.description: An instrument as one group trades it.

LinkLoginRequest.description: The token from a login link.

LockReason.description: Why new orders are locked until the next trading day.

LockTradingRequest.description: Locks new orders until the next trading day (ADR 0054). With ClosePositions every position closes too.

LoginLinkResponse.description: Open Url once before ExpiresAt to be logged in to the terminal.

LoginRequest.description: Server is the id of the firm's server, as in MetaTrader.

nextChange.description: When the market closes if it is open, or opens if it is closed. Null if it never closes, or does not open within a month.

sessions.description: The periods the market is open from now and a week on, in UTC, the current one first. Null if it never closes.

MarketHours.description: When a symbol's market is open, seen from the moment it was asked. A market that never closes has no next change and no sessions.

MarketPeriod.description: A period when a market is open, in UTC.

MeResponse.description:
The logged in trader, their firm's server and the accounts they own, with what the firm says about each in
AccountDetails, in the same order. Orders, closes and stop changes are refused while the latest
price is older than MaxPriceAgeSeconds.

ModifyOrderRequest.description: A pending order's new price and stops.

ModifyStopsRequest.description: A position's stops. With TrailingStop the stop loss follows the price at the distance it is set at.

NoticeResponse.description: The firm's notice for its terminals, or null when there is none.

OrderSnapshot.description: A pending order. TrailingDistance is set when the position it opens gets a trailing stop.

OwnLimits.description:
Limits the trader sets for themselves, stricter than the firm's (ADR 0054). DailyLoss and
DailyTarget are amounts below and above the balance the trading day started with: reaching either
closes every position and locks new orders until the next trading day. MaxTrades is how many
positions may open in a trading day. An empty limit is off.

OwnLimitsRequest.description:
The trader's own limits (ADR 0054): a daily loss limit and a daily profit target in the account currency, counted
from the balance the trading day started with, and the most positions to open in a day. An empty limit is off. A
stricter limit applies at once and a looser one from the next trading day.

OwnLimitsSnapshot.description:
The trader's own limits on an account now. Pending are the limits from the next trading day, when
the trader loosened one. LossLevel and TargetLevel are the equity at which the
daily loss limit and profit target are reached today. Lock is set while new orders are locked.

OwnLock.description: New orders are locked until Until, the start of the next trading day, for the reason.

PlaceOrderRequest.description:
Places an order. The client creates the order id, so a retry can never place the order twice. With
TrailingStop the stop loss follows the price at the distance it is set at.

PlatformInstrument.description: An instrument on the platform. ContractSize is the units of the base currency in one lot.

PointValue.description:
What a one point move on one lot of the symbol is worth in the account currency, at the latest conversion rate.
Profit is points times volume times PerLot, before rounding and commission.

PositionSnapshot.description:
An open position. CurrentPrice is the price it would close at now. TrailingDistance is set when the stop loss trails
the price at that distance.

PriceFeedStatus.description: How the platform's price feed is doing (ADR 0053): when the last price came for each symbol, and whether its market is open.

PriceGap.description: A period of at least a minute in which no price came for the symbols the account traded.

PricePoint.description: A raw price from the feed at a moment.

ReceiptClose.description:
A part closed or the close: its fill, its profit before commission, why it closed and, for a stop loss or take
profit, the level it was set at when known.

ReceiptFill.description:
One fill: the opening, a part closed or the close. Price is the price the account got, and
Feed the raw price the engine had from the feed at that moment, with
MarkupPoints between them on the filled side: the ask for a buy's opening and a sell's close, the
bid otherwise. Both are null when the price cannot be found. Prices are the feed's prices a minute
before and after.

ReceiptOrder.description: The limit or stop order a position came from, as it was placed.

ReopenAccountRequest.description: The balance a disabled account opens again with (ADR 0053).

ServerInfo.description:
A firm's server: the id traders log in with and the firm's name. With LoginUrl, the firm's
traders log in there, for example on the firm's portal, which opens the terminal with a one-time link.
LogoUrl is the firm's logo, when it has one.

SettingsResponse.description: The trader's settings in the terminal, by key.

leverage.description: Margin is the position value divided by this.

spreadMarkupPoints.description: Points added to the raw spread. The bid is lowered by half, rounded down, and the ask raised by the rest.

commissionPerLotPerSide.description: Commission in account currency, charged both on open and on close.

bidMarkupPoints.description: Points the bid is lowered by.

askMarkupPoints.description: Points the ask is raised by.

SymbolConditions.description: Conditions for one symbol within a group.

SymbolPrice.description: Price after the group's spread markup, with the time the raw price arrived.

TenantGroupResponse.description: A firm's trading group and its account currency.

TenantResponse.description:
A firm. Only Listed servers are on the list traders choose from. LoginUrl is
where the terminal sends the firm's traders to log in, or null when they log in with a password.
LogoUrl is the firm's logo, which the terminal shows with its name.

TerminalNotice.description:
What the firm's terminals show at the top, for example that the price feed has stopped and what the firm does about
it (ADR 0053). Url is where the trader reads more, such as the firm's status page.

TerminalNoticeRequest.description:
A notice for the firm's terminals (ADR 0053): a short title, the text, how serious it is and where the trader
reads more, such as the firm's status page.

TradeReceipt.description:
What a trade was and the prices behind it (ADR 0053): the limit or stop order it came from, its opening and each
close. Profit is the closes' profit before commission so far, and Result the
profit after all commission once the position is closed. Amounts are in Currency.

TradingDay.description:
When an account's trading day starts: at Start on the clock of TimeZone, an IANA
id such as Europe/Stockholm. The firm's day, which its daily loss limit follows too, and which the trader's own
limits count from (ADR 0054). A day is named by the local date it starts on, as in the firm's system.

TradingDayRequest.description: When the account's trading day starts, as the firm counts it (ADR 0054): an IANA time zone and the local time.

currency.description: Account currency for all accounts in the group.

stopOutLevelPercent.description: Positions are closed when the margin level falls below this. 0 disables stop out.

symbols.description: The symbols the group may trade, with their conditions.

TradingGroup.description: Trading conditions shared by a group of accounts, set by the firm.

UpdateTenantRequest.description: What to change about a firm. Null leaves it as it is. An empty LoginUrl or LogoUrl removes it.
